title: Spectrochemical series and ligand-field strength
basic_overview: Ligands produce different Δ values; strong-field ligands tend to favour pairing for d⁴–d⁷ octahedral ions.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Weak field → small Δ; strong field → large Δ.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Identify ligand. 2. Rank strength. 3. Compare Δ and P. 4. Predict spin.
extra_info_content.factors: Empirical series; covalency can modify simple CFT expectations.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
